title: Home practical guide and safety card: plant hunt
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Skeletons, muscles, nutrition and plants (Tribal Tales)
source: Written for science/y3 lesson 20 (Home practical guide and safety card: plant hunt (portal worksheet; adult present, never eat any part of a plant))
intro: Lesson 20: Comparing plants around the home. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To compare plants around the home
safety: Never eat any part of a plant
An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Go round the home and garden with an adult
Look at the leaves, stem and flowers or seeds of each
Do not pick or eat any part of a plant
Draw one plant and label its parts

questions.a: Find what is the same and different
options: Find what is the same and different

questions.q: Big question: why do a cactus and a lettuce look so different?
questions.a: They are suited to different places; the cactus stores water and saves it.
